name: The Grumbling Vault
description: Deep beneath the Aelerian foothills, a sealed chamber holds the Keystone of Unmaking – a fist-sized chunk of obsidian that can destabilize any ward within a mile. The Aeler locked it away centuries ago, but the wards have grown senile. They tick and pulse like a failing heart. Your goal: retrieve the keystone for a bitter old drunk who claims it's owed to him. By his beard, you'll earn every coin.
author: Nicholas A. Gasper
